inspiration.observed_pattern: INSERT IGNORE combines two correlated JSON_TABLE projections with UNION ALL before inserting relational facet rows.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one catalog document, one genre value, one tag value, and one existing target row while retaining the two JSON_TABLE branches, UNION ALL, and duplicate-key skip path. DISTINCT, extra documents, empty arrays, and unrelated target rows are removed.

fixture_notes: The existing genre row must remain unchanged, while the new tag row must be inserted by the union source.
determinism_notes: One fixed document and one ordered final read; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE mini_catalog (entry_id INT PRIMARY KEY, genres JSON NOT NULL, tags JSON NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE mini_facets (entry_id INT NOT NULL, facet_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, facet_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (entry_id, facet_kind, facet_name))
INSERT INTO mini_catalog (entry_id, genres, tags) VALUES (7, '["strategy"]', '["featured"]')
INSERT INTO mini_facets (entry_id, facet_kind, facet_name) VALUES (7, 'genre', 'strategy')

steps.sql: INSERT IGNORE INTO mini_facets (entry_id, facet_kind, facet_name) SELECT c.entry_id, 'genre', g.value FROM mini_catalog AS c CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(c.genres, '$[*]' COLUMNS (value VARCHAR(32) PATH '$')) AS g UNION ALL SELECT c.entry_id, 'tag', t.value FROM mini_catalog AS c CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(c.tags, '$[*]' COLUMNS (value VARCHAR(32) PATH '$')) AS t

checks.sql: SELECT entry_id, facet_kind, facet_name FROM mini_facets ORDER BY entry_id, facet_kind, facet_name
